faqs.a: Each sign needs a separate sign permit (wall signs separated by a distance of more than three feet shall be considered separate signs). Provide the following with the application: For signs in Olde Town or Reno Park, you will first need to include a Certificate of Compliance with Design Guidelines (Apply through the Planning Department) Sign Elevation and Detail plan with measurements indicated Plot Plan showing where on the property and/or the building where the sign/s will be located; Signed letter of permission from property owner
